cmd: curl -s localhost:8080/api/v1/customers/72/hub | jq '{customer: .profile[0] | {first_name, last_name, loyalty_tier}, retail: .retail[0], travel: .travel[0], value: .value[0], trips_at_risk: (.at_risk_trips | length)}'
